ROCKSTAROS / SIM + eSIM SERVICE ACCESS

One SIM.
A whole team of AI.

A physical SIM or eSIM purchase is designed to include access to RockstarOS, Sky, Zema and integrated agents. Sign in once, find an agent, give it a task, and keep the work moving.

See how to get started ↗ Explore the flow ↓

SIM/eSIM is the service and connectivity entry point. The RockstarOS binary does not live on the SIM.

START HERE

Start with the benefit.

When a supported SIM/eSIM offer is available, link its purchase access once at RockstarOS Connect. You can then open Sky, Zema and Agents with one Rockstar account. Carrier activation and Rockstar service access are verified separately.

01 / ACCESS

Cloud AI, with less setup.

Open Sky to find agents and tools. Use Zema to submit work, follow progress and collect results with one Rockstar account.

02 / PRICING

Know the cost before you run.

See rates and an estimate, approve a spending limit, follow current usage, then review an itemized receipt. Carrier service and AI usage are separate charges.

03 / CONTINUITY

Your work can continue offline.

After a cloud task is accepted and authorized, cloud agents can continue within its approved budget and deadline while your device is disconnected. Results sync when you reconnect.

FROM SIM TO SERVICE

A short path to
your AI team.

  1. 01
    Choose a SIM or eSIM offer

    Offers are intended to be available through Rockstar, carriers, device retailers and online channels.

  2. 02
    Activate your mobile service

    Add an eSIM with the carrier or insert a physical SIM, then verify carrier activation.

  3. 03
    Sign in once and link access

    Connect the purchase entitlement to your Rockstar account. Sky, Zema and agents share that identity.

  4. 04
    Use the install path for your device

    Install the signed OS only on an exact supported model with a validated recovery path. Other devices use an app or browser client on their existing OS.

  5. 05
    Submit work and follow it

    Choose an agent, review the estimate and cap, approve, then return for progress, results and itemized usage.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS

Designed for the service.
Connections are still being built.

Sales, physical SIM fulfillment, carrier activation, channel entitlement linking, production AI pricing and billing, and supported-device OS installation are not available yet. The eSIM catalog is for contract and compatibility review; it does not accept purchases.
